properties.title: Typed Data Signing Requires Account Unlock
properties.description: Before signing typed data, the requested account must be unlocked
properties.formal_expression: FORALL sign : eth_signTypedData :: sign.executed() IMPLIES get_account(sign.address).is_unlocked()

properties.title: User Approval Required Before Signing
properties.description: The hash must not be signed until user has explicitly approved the request
properties.formal_expression: FORALL sign : SignHash :: sign.executed() IMPLIES user_approval.granted AND user_approval.timestamp < sign.timestamp

properties.title: Final Hash Format Invariant
properties.description: The final signable hash must be keccak256(0x19 || 0x01 || domainSeparator || hashStruct(message))
properties.formal_expression: FORALL hash : FinalHash :: hash.value == keccak256(0x19 || 0x01 || hash.domain_separator || hash.struct_hash)

properties.title: Type Hash Determinism
properties.description: Type hash must be deterministically computed as keccak256(encodeType(typeName))
properties.formal_expression: FORALL type : TypeDefinition :: typeHash(type) == keccak256(encodeType(type)) AND encodeType(type) == 'TypeName(type1 member1,...)'

properties.title: Signature Output Format
properties.description: After signing, the output must be a 65-byte ECDSA signature (r, s, v)
properties.formal_expression: FORALL sign : SignHash :: AFTER(sign) IMPLIES sign.output.length == 65 AND sign.output == (r || s || v)

properties.title: Struct Hash Includes Type Hash
properties.description: hashStruct must always include typeHash as first element: keccak256(typeHash || encodeData(s))
properties.formal_expression: FORALL struct : StructHash :: struct.value == keccak256(struct.typeHash || encodeData(struct.data))

properties.title: Domain Separator Must Include ChainId
properties.description: For on-chain verification, domain separator should include chainId to prevent cross-chain replays
properties.formal_expression: FORALL domain : EIP712Domain :: domain.for_onchain_verification IMPLIES domain.chainId != null AND domain.chainId == current_chain_id

properties.title: Cross-Domain Replay Prevention
properties.description: Signature verification must check domain separator matches the verifying contract
properties.formal_expression: FORALL verify : VerifySignature :: verify.accepted() IMPLIES verify.computed_domain_separator == verify.expected_domain_separator

properties.title: Domain Mismatch Blocks Verification
properties.description: When domain separator doesn't match, signature verification must fail
properties.formal_expression: FORALL verify : VerifySignature :: verify.computed_domain != verify.expected_domain IMPLIES verify.rejected() AND error.reason == 'domain_mismatch'

properties.title: Application-Level Replay Protection Required
properties.description: Applications using EIP-712 must implement their own replay protection (nonce tracking)
properties.formal_expression: FORALL app : EIP712Application :: app.secure IMPLIES app.has_nonce_tracking AND FORALL sig : Signature :: app.used(sig) IMPLIES NOT app.reusable(sig)

properties.title: Wallet Must Display Typed Data to User
properties.description: Before user approval, wallet must present human-readable structured data representation
properties.formal_expression: FORALL request : SignRequest :: user_approval.granted IMPLIES wallet.displayed(request.typed_data) AND display.human_readable == true

properties.title: Fork Activation Block Number Check
properties.description: Fork rules activate only when block number >= fork activation block for the network
properties.formal_expression: FORALL block : Block :: muir_glacier_rules_active(block) IMPLIES block.number >= FORK_BLOCK[block.chain_id]

properties.title: Mainnet Fork Block Constant
properties.description: Mainnet fork activation block must be exactly 9,200,000
properties.formal_expression: FORALL chain : Chain :: chain.id == MAINNET IMPLIES FORK_BLOCK[chain.id] == 9200000

properties.title: Ropsten Fork Block Constant
properties.description: Ropsten testnet fork activation block must be exactly 7,117,117
properties.formal_expression: FORALL chain : Chain :: chain.id == ROPSTEN IMPLIES FORK_BLOCK[chain.id] == 7117117

properties.title: PoA Networks Not Affected
properties.description: PoA networks (Kovan, Rinkeby, Gorli) are not affected by this fork
properties.formal_expression: FORALL chain : Chain :: chain.consensus == POA IMPLIES muir_glacier_rules_active(chain) == false

properties.title: EIP-2384 Activated After Fork
properties.description: After fork activation, EIP-2384 difficulty bomb delay rules must be in effect
properties.formal_expression: FORALL block : Block :: block.number >= FORK_BLOCK[block.chain_id] AND block.chain.consensus == POW IMPLIES eip2384_rules_active(block)

properties.title: Fake Block Number Applied for Difficulty
properties.description: Post-fork difficulty calculation must use the fake (offset) block number
properties.formal_expression: FORALL block : Block :: eip2384_rules_active(block) IMPLIES difficulty_calc_uses(block.fake_block_number) AND block.fake_block_number < block.number

properties.title: Difficulty Bomb Delayed Effect
properties.description: The difficulty bomb effect is delayed by using the offset block number
properties.formal_expression: FORALL block : Block :: AFTER(eip2384_activation) IMPLIES bomb_effect(block) < bomb_effect_without_offset(block)

properties.title: Max Blobs Per Block Electra
properties.description: Maximum blobs per block must be 9 after Prague/Electra activation
properties.formal_expression: FORALL block : Block :: prague_active(block) IMPLIES max_blobs_per_block == 9

properties.title: Target Blobs Per Block Electra
properties.description: Target blobs per block must be 6 after Prague/Electra activation
properties.formal_expression: FORALL block : Block :: prague_active(block) IMPLIES target_blobs_per_block == 6

properties.title: Max Blob Gas Per Block
properties.description: Maximum blob gas per block must be 1,179,648 (9 * 131,072)
properties.formal_expression: FORALL block : Block :: prague_active(block) IMPLIES MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK == 1179648

properties.title: Target Blob Gas Per Block
properties.description: Target blob gas per block must be 786,432 (6 * 131,072)
properties.formal_expression: FORALL block : Block :: prague_active(block) IMPLIES TARGET_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK == 786432

properties.title: Blob Base Fee Update Fraction
properties.description: Blob base fee update fraction must be 5,007,716 for Prague
properties.formal_expression: FORALL block : Block :: prague_active(block) IMPLIES BLOB_BASE_FEE_UPDATE_FRACTION == 5007716

properties.title: Blob Count Validation Before Acceptance
properties.description: Block must pass blob count validation before being accepted
properties.formal_expression: FORALL block : Block :: block.accepted() IMPLIES count_blobs(block) <= MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK

properties.title: Full Block Increases Blob Base Fee
properties.description: When block contains maximum blobs, base fee increases approximately 8.2%
properties.formal_expression: FORALL block : Block :: count_blobs(block) == 9 IMPLIES next_blob_base_fee >= current_blob_base_fee * 1.08

properties.title: Empty Block Decreases Blob Base Fee
properties.description: When block contains no blobs, base fee decreases approximately 14.5%
properties.formal_expression: FORALL block : Block :: count_blobs(block) == 0 IMPLIES next_blob_base_fee <= current_blob_base_fee * 0.86

properties.title: Target Block Maintains Stable Fee
properties.description: When block contains exactly target blobs (6), base fee remains stable
properties.formal_expression: FORALL block : Block :: count_blobs(block) == TARGET_BLOBS IMPLIES next_blob_base_fee == current_blob_base_fee

properties.title: Exceeding Max Blobs Invalidates Block
properties.description: Blocks with more than 9 blobs must be rejected as invalid
properties.formal_expression: FORALL block : Block :: count_blobs(block) > 9 IMPLIES block.rejected() AND error.reason == 'too_many_blobs'

properties.title: Prague Fork Transition Precondition
properties.description: New blob parameters only apply from first block of Prague fork onward
properties.formal_expression: FORALL block : Block :: uses_prague_blob_params(block) IMPLIES block.number >= PRAGUE_FORK_BLOCK

properties.title: EL and CL Parameters Sync
properties.description: Execution layer and consensus layer must both activate new parameters at fork
properties.formal_expression: FORALL fork : PragueFork :: AFTER(fork) IMPLIES EL.max_blob_gas == 1179648 AND CL.max_blobs_per_block == 9
